subject: Sponsorship slate and speaking slots for DevTooling Day @ DataWorks Live
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@brightai.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsorship slate and speaking slots for DevTooling Day @ DataWorks Live

Hi Elena —

Following up on our quick chat at the Partner Summit — Redwood would love to co-sponsor a dedicated "DevTooling Day" at DataWorks Live (Oct 5 pre-day). High-level ask: share a speaking slot (30–45 mins), joint booth/table, a joint customer panel (one customer + 2 speakers), and coordinated promotional assets (blog swap + email).

Quick questions so we can put together a formal proposal:
- Do you have interest in a single co-branded session + panel, or would BrightAI prefer two smaller technical lightning talks?
- Are you able to commit to a 50/50 cost split on basic sponsorship (booth + promo)? if not, what cost-share looks right for you?
- Who on your side will own marketing assets + speaker coordination (name/email)?

Attached is Redwood's DevToolingDay_Sponsor_Package.pdf with suggested program & rough budget. If you're open, can we aim to lock the slot by end of next week? Happy to run a 30-min sync to align program and PR timeline.

Thanks — excited about this one.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0188

Attachments: DevToolingDay_Sponsor_Package.pdf

From: Elena Soto <elena@brightai.com>

Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@brightai.com>, BrightAI Events <events@brightai.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsorship slate and speaking slots for DevTooling Day @ DataWorks Live

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the note and the package — BrightAI is definitely interested. A couple of quick points:
- We like the single co-branded session + customer panel idea. We could do two lightning talks but prefer the one marquee session for reach.
- Cost share: 50/50 on booth/promo should be fine but we need to confirm with finance; will likely be ok.
- I'll hand Lina Park (cc'd) to own marketing + speaker coordination on our side. Lina will also loop in our events operations for logistics.

We should be able to confirm the slot by next Thursday. In parallel, we'll start drafting a short MSA addendum for sponsorships — I'll share legal contact if needed.

Would love a quick sync early next week — Lina and I are available Tue/Wed afternoons PT.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Strategic Partnerships, BrightAI
elena@brightai.com

Hi all —

Logistics snapshot (DataWorks Live events ops):
- Available pre-day slots (Oct 5): 09:30–10:15 (preferred morning), 14:00–14:45 (afternoon). Both are 45-min windows for a talk + 15-min panel.
- Booth: standard table (6ft) for basic sponsor; option to upgrade to 10x10 for additional $4,500.
- AV: standard projector + lapel mic included; request stage plot 3 weeks before for any special AV hookups.
- Deadlines: final speaker names / bios due Sept 10. Promo assets (logos, short blurbs) due Sept 15.

I'll attach the marketing timeline and the sponsorship order form link — please use the order form so finance tracking is straightforward. Early-bird registration discount for sponsors ends June 1.

Attachments: marketing_timeline.xlsx
Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1example
Order form: https://events.dataworkslive.com/sponsor-order-form

If you want, we can take the 09:30 slot; that gives better visibility into the main flow.

— Jonas Weber
Senior Events Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Thanks, team —

Great alignment. Proposed next steps and owners:
1) Lock 09:30–10:15 speaking slot (Jonas to confirm with DataWorks ops and submit order form) — owner: jonas_weber — target: Mon Apr 19
2) Legal & finance check on 50/50 cost split (Elena to confirm, Camila to loop Redwood finance if needed) — owner: camila_reyes / elena.soto — target: Thu Apr 22
3) Speaker list + bios (Soojin to draft joint panel + ask BrightAI for one customer) — owner: soojin_lee — target: Fri Sep 10
4) Marketing assets & blog swap draft (Camila to prepare outline; Lina to provide BrightAI assets) — owner: camila_reyes / lina.park — target: Sep 15

Can everyone confirm the owners and timelines? If yes, let's do a 30-min sync Tue Apr 20 at 2:00pm PT — Lina & Elena ok?

Thanks — looking forward to making this a high-impact co-marketing moment.
